blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) build on a pretrained visual encoder that provides a strong visual prior. Encoder-free MLLMs instead learn visual representations directly from raw pixels, offering a simple and unified architecture, but their scaling behavior has not been systematically characterized. To fill this gap, we compare scaling laws for encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs and report three main findings: (1) Removing the visual encoder shifts the compute-optimal allocation for the multimodal objective toward larger models, while leaving that for text nearly unchanged. (2) The two architectures exhibit nearly overlapping loss–compute frontiers on the text objective, but diverge on the multimodal objective: encoder-free models underperform at small scales yet are predicted to catch up at around 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs, well within practical pretraining budgets. (3) Without a visual encoder, the language model learns to take over its role via vision-specific adaptation: bidirectional interactions among visual tokens become increasingly beneficial as training compute grows, visual processing shifts toward earlier layers, and expert routing for visual tokens becomes more concentrated.
Overall, our results indicate that the advantage of the visual prior provided by a pretrained encoder diminishes with scale, positioning encoder-free architectures as a promising direction for multimodal pretraining.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Most modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 37 , 2 , 23 ] adopt an encoder-based architecture: a pretrained visual encoder [ 47 , 58 ] supplies the language model with semantically rich visual representations, providing a strong visual prior learned from large-scale image–text data.
To achieve a simple and unified architecture, encoder-free MLLMs remove the visual encoder and feed projected image patches directly into the decoder, which must then learn visual representations from raw pixels [ 3 , 13 , 9 , 30 , 14 , 22 , 39 , 54 ] .
Although these studies show initial feasibility, the scaling behavior of encoder-free MLLMs has not been systematically characterized.
blocks.zh:
大多数现代的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)[37,2,23]采用基于编码器的架构:一种经过预先训练的视觉编码器[47,58]为语言模型提供了精致丰富的视觉表现,提供了从大规模图像-文本数据中学习到的强大的视觉前传.
为了实现简单统一的架构,无编码器的MLLMs移除了视觉编码器,并将投影的图像补丁直接输入解码器,解码器随后必须学习原始像素的视觉表现[3,13,9,30,14,22,39,54].
虽然这些研究表明初步可行性,但是没有编码器的MLLMs的缩放行为还没有被系统地定性.

blocks.en:
To this end, we conduct a controlled scaling study of encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs, in which the two model families share the same sparse decoder ladder, data mixture, optimization setup, and visual-token granularity.
We fit scaling laws separately for the text and multimodal objectives to quantify how the efficiency gap between the two architectures evolves with scale.
To understand the mechanisms behind these trends, we further probe the decoder’s internals and examine how it compensates for the missing visual encoder.
Our main findings are as follows.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们开展了对无编码器和基于编码器的MLLMs的可控缩放研究,其中两个模型家族共享同样的稀疏的解码器阶梯,数据混合,优化设置,以及可视化的粒状.
我们为文本和多式联运目标分别调整法律,以量化两种结构之间的效率差距如何随规模而演变。
为了了解这些趋势背后的机制,我们进一步探究解码器的内部,并研究它如何补偿缺失的视觉编码器.
我们的主要调查结果如下。

(3) The decoder takes over visual encoding via vision-specific adaptation (§ 3.3 ).
The decoder increasingly relies on bidirectional attention among visual tokens, recovering the patch-level contextualization that a visual encoder would otherwise provide.
Moreover, visual token representations diverge from their inputs much earlier than in encoder-based models, so the shallow decoder layers effectively serve as an implicit visual encoding stage, whereas text tokens are processed almost identically in both architectures.
This vision-specific adaptation further extends to the MoE experts, where the routing of visual tokens becomes more concentrated, consistent with some experts taking over the vision-specific role of the visual encoder.
These adaptations suggest that encoder-free models may benefit from decoder architectures designed explicitly for native visual representation learning, rather than directly inheriting designs built for language.
blocks.zh:
(3)解码器通过视向特定适应(§3.3)接管视觉编码.
解码器越来越依赖于视觉符号中的双向关注,恢复视觉编码器否则会提供的补丁级背景化.
此外,视觉符号表示方式与其输入方式远早于基于编码器的模型,因此浅解码器层实际上起到隐含的视觉编码阶段的作用,而文本符号在两种架构中处理几乎相同.
这种针对视觉的适应进一步扩展到教育部专家,视觉符号的路由越来越集中,这与一些专家接管视觉编码器针对视觉的作用是一致的。
这些改编表明,无编码器模型可能得益于明确为本土视觉表现学习设计的解码器架构,而不是直接继承为语言构建的设计.

blocks.en:
Overall, encoder-free models require more training compute within the fitted range, but their more rapidly improving multimodal frontier predicts an efficiency crossover within practical pretraining budgets.
These findings position encoder-free architectures as a promising direction, and we expect this work to encourage broader exploration of encoder-free multimodal pretraining.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,无编码器模型需要在相应范围内进行更多的培训计算,但是,它们更迅速改进的多式联运前沿预估了实际培训前预算的效率交叉。
这些调查结果认为无编码器架构是一个很有希望的方向,我们期望这项工作鼓励更广泛地探索无编码器的多式联运预训。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Architectural comparison of encoder-based and encoder-free MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 图 2:基于编码器和无编码器的MLLMs的建筑对比.

blocks.en:
We compare encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs on a matched ladder of 11 sparse MoE language models with 1.1B–44B total and 71M–2.4B active non-embedding parameters, sharing the same data mixture, optimization setup, and visual-token granularity.
As shown in Fig. 2 , the encoder-based model encodes images with a pretrained SigLIP 2 ViT [ 58 ] , followed by a ConvPool adapter and a projector, and applies causal attention to all tokens.
Following common practice [ 2 , 23 ] , the ViT keeps the same size across decoder scales and is trained jointly with the decoder.
The encoder-free model instead maps raw image patches into the decoder through a patch projection [ 22 ] , where visual tokens attend bidirectionally within each image [ 22 , 14 , 39 , 19 ] and all other attention remains causal. We also study a fully causal variant.
More implementation details are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
In this section, we explore how removing the pretrained visual encoder changes the scaling behavior of the language model.
§ 3.1 first examines how encoder removal changes compute-optimal allocation.
§ 3.2 then uses the resulting allocation laws to test whether encoder-free models can catch up at scale, under both compute-optimal allocation and overtraining.
Finally, § 3.3 examines how the decoder takes over visual encoding through vision-specific adaptation.

§3.2 然后使用由此产生的分配法来测试无编码器模型在计算-优化分配和过度训练下是否能够大规模赶上。
最后,第3.3节探讨了解码器如何通过视向特定适应来取代视觉编码.

The aggregate multimodal loss summarizes the overall trend but obscures variation across topics.
We therefore repeat the analysis at equal loss on each major multimodal topic (Fig. 6 ). Appendix F reports the underlying IsoFLOP profiles.

blocks.en:
Within our compute range, encoder-free models remain less compute-efficient than encoder-based models on every topic, yet topics differ markedly in the size of the remaining gap and how quickly it narrows with scale.
Extrapolating the fitted laws, encoder-free models catch up first on STEM, which is already close to parity at the largest fitted budget, then on Charts, whose gap narrows quickly, and considerably later on GUI, OCR, and Caption.
This ordering is consistent with how strongly each topic relies on pretrained visual representations.
The STEM subset consists mainly of text, symbols, and simple diagrams, and chart inputs can often be reduced to symbolic content. Once this content is extracted, prediction depends mainly on language and reasoning.
By contrast, captioning requires rich representations of natural images, while GUI and OCR demand detailed spatial and textual perception, for which a pretrained encoder provides a strong prior that encoder-free models must learn from scratch.
blocks.zh:
在我们的计算范围内,没有编码器的模型在每一个主题上的计算效率仍然低于基于编码器的模型,然而在剩余差距的大小和与尺度的缩小速度上,主题却明显不同.
外推配定律,无编码器模型首先赶上STEM, 在最大配定预算上已经接近对等,然后在图表上,其差距迅速缩小,在GUI、OCR和Caption上则相当晚。
这种顺序与每个主题如何强烈地依赖预先训练的视觉表现是一致的.
STEM子集主要包括文本,符号,和简单的图表,图表输入往往可以简化为符号内容. 一旦这一内容被提取出来,预测主要取决于语言和推理.
与此相对照,字幕需要丰富的自然图像表现,而GUI和OCR则需要详细的空间和文字感知,为此,一个事先经过训练的编码器提供了强烈的前奏,即没有编码器的模型必须从零开始学习.

blocks.en: Takeaway 3. The crossover varies by topic, arriving earlier on topics that rely mainly on language (e.g., STEM) and much later on perception-intensive ones (e.g., Caption) (Fig. 6 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 How Does the Decoder Take Over Visual Encoding?
blocks.zh: 3.3 解码器如何超越视觉编码?

blocks.en: Figure 7: Visual learning across training tokens. (A, B) Multimodal validation loss during training. (C) Attention mass on visual tokens per decoder layer for the 8B models, before and after the encoder-free loss drop (shaded in A, B).

blocks.en: Removing the visual encoder shifts visual representation learning into the decoder. To trace this shift, we first compare how the multimodal loss of encoder-free and encoder-based models evolves over training tokens, and then examine three probes inside the decoder: attention over visual tokens, layerwise evolution of visual representations, and expert routing.
blocks.zh: 删除视觉编码器将视觉表现学习转移到解码器. 为了追踪这一变化,我们首先比较了无编码器和基于编码器的模型的多模式丢失如何在训练符上演化,然后检查解码器内部的三个探针:注意力相对于视觉符,视觉表现的分层演化,以及专家的路由.

blocks.en:
Emergence of Visual Encoding During Training. The multimodal loss of encoder-based models decreases smoothly, whereas that of encoder-free models decreases slowly at first, then drops sharply within a short span (Fig. 7 A).
To understand this drop, we compare attention to visual tokens in the 8B models before and after it: at layer 12, the encoder-free model’s attention to visual tokens rises from 0.217 0.217 to 0.645 0.645 , approaching that of the encoder-based model (Fig. 7 C).
We hypothesize that the slow early phase reflects the decoder bootstrapping its own visual representations. Since the loss is applied only to text tokens, visual tokens receive learning signal only when text attends to them. Initially uninformative and thus ignored, they learn slowly until they become useful enough to attract attention, after which learning accelerates. A pretrained encoder supplies useful visual representations from the start and thus avoids this stage, consistent with the high attention to visual tokens in the encoder-based model at both checkpoints.
At every multimodal IsoFLOP budget, the compute-optimal models have already
passed this drop, so the fitted frontier reflects the smooth regime after it.
blocks.zh:
训练期间视觉编码的出现. 以编码器为基础的模型的多式联运损失会平稳减少,而无编码器模型起初会缓慢减少,然后在短时间内急剧下降(图7 A)。
为了了解这一下降,我们比较了8B型机车前后的视觉信号符的注意:在第12层,无编码器型机车对视觉信号符的注意从0.217 0.217上升到0.645 0.645,接近了基于编码器型机车的注意(图7 C).
我们假设早期缓慢的阶段 反映了解码器的靴子 由于损失仅适用于文本符号,视觉符号只有在文本关注时才能接收学习信号. 最初没有信息化,因而被忽略,他们慢慢学习,直到变得足够有用,吸引注意力,之后学习加速. 预先训练的编码器从一开始就提供有用的视觉表现,从而避免这一阶段,这与两个检查站基于编码器的模型对视觉标志的高度关注是一致的。
在每一个多式联运IsoFLOP预算中,计算-最佳模型已经
通过这一滴,所以安装的边界反映了之后的平稳政权.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Comparison between causal and bidirectional attention on visual tokens. Values above 1.0 1.0 favor causal.
blocks.zh: 图8:视觉符号上的因果关系和双向关注的比较. 数值高于1.01.0偏好因果.

blocks.en:
Encoder-Like Contextualization: Bidirectional Attention. We compare bidirectional and causal attention over visual tokens by rerunning the encoder-free ladder with the causal variant (Fig. 8 ).
Causal attention is slightly better on the text objective at the measured budgets, reaching the same loss for about 1 % 1\% less compute ( EG C = 1.011 \mathrm{EG}^{C}=1.011 ), but this gain shrinks with compute.
On the multimodal objective, causal attention is mildly worse on average ( EG C = 0.990 \mathrm{EG}^{C}=0.990 ), and the multimodal gain of bidirectional attention becomes larger with compute.
This pattern is consistent with a transfer of function from encoder to decoder.
In encoder-based models, the ViT bidirectionally contextualizes image patches before they reach the decoder.
Once the ViT is removed, bidirectional attention among visual tokens allows the decoder to assume part of this role.
The increasing multimodal benefit of bidirectional attention with scale suggests that larger decoders exploit these interactions better, while its diminishing cost on text indicates limited interference with language modeling.
blocks.zh:
编码器-类似背景:双向关注. 我们通过重新运行无编码器的阶梯与因果变体(图8),将双向和因果的注意比作视觉符号.
对所计量预算的文本目标来说,引起注意略好一些,在大约1%的1%的计算中达到同样的损失(EG C = 1.011\mathrm{EG}^{C}=1.011),但这种增益通过计算收缩.
在多式联运目标上,因果注意的平均程度略差(EG C = 0.990\mathrm{EG}^{C}=0.990),双向注意的多式联运收益随着计算而增大.
这种模式与函数从编码器转移到解码器一致.
在基于编码器的模型中,ViT双向在到达解码器前对图像补丁进行上下文化.
一旦ViT被移除,视觉符号中的双向关注允许解码器承担部分这个角色.
双向关注和规模的日益增加的多式联运好处表明,较大的解码器可以更好地利用这些相互作用,而文本成本的减少表明对语言模型的干扰有限。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Layerwise representation evolution. Cosine similarity to the input representation at layer 0 across decoder layers for visual tokens (left) and text tokens (right).
blocks.zh: 图 9:分层表示演化. 与 0 层的输入表示值相近,用于视觉符号(左)和文本符号(右).

blocks.en:
Encoder-Like Early Processing: Layerwise Representation Evolution. In encoder-based MLLMs, the ViT has already transformed visual tokens into semantic representations, so they undergo little additional processing in shallow decoder layers [ 18 ] .
If the decoder takes over this transformation, its shallow layers should instead rewrite visual tokens substantially.
Fig. 9 tests this using cosine similarity between each layer’s token representations and their layer-0 inputs.
Without the visual encoder, visual tokens move away from their inputs much earlier (left), while text token trajectories remain close across the two systems (right). The same pattern holds across model scales (Appendix E.1 ).
The shallow decoder layers thus act as an implicit visual encoding stage, performing the transformation that the ViT performs in encoder-based models, and this change is specific to visual tokens.
blocks.zh:
Encoder- Like 早期处理:图层表达式演化. 在基于编码器的MLLMs中,ViT已经将视觉符号转化为语义表示,因此它们在浅解码层中很少进行额外的处理[18].
如果解码器接管了这种变换,则其浅层应当大量重写视觉符号.
图9利用每一层的符号表示值与其0层输入值之间的余弦相似度进行测试。
没有视觉编码器,视觉符号会远离其输入的更早(左),而文本符号轨迹在两个系统(右)之间仍然很接近. 同样的模式存在于各种模型尺度(附录E.1)。
浅解码器层因此起到隐含的视觉编码阶段的作用,进行ViT在基于编码器的模型中完成的转换,这种变化是针对视觉符号的.

blocks.en:
Encoder-Like Dedicated Capacity: Expert Routing. Both systems use the same sparse decoder, so routing differences show how the decoder absorbs the changed visual representations.
We quantify expert load imbalance using MaxVio [ 60 ] , the relative excess of the most-loaded expert’s load over the perfectly balanced load.
As shown in Fig. 10 , both systems have similarly low overall MaxVio when visual and text tokens are aggregated, although the encoder-free values are slightly higher.
Separating tokens by modality reveals substantially greater expert load imbalance for both visual and text tokens than the aggregate suggests.
For text tokens, the two architectures remain closely matched.
In contrast, across the four largest model sizes, encoder-free models exhibit consistently higher average MaxVio and a wider band for visual tokens throughout training.
The close match on text argues against a routing shift across the whole model and localizes the effect to visual processing.
This concentration is consistent with the decoder allocating a subset of its experts to play the role of the vision-specific parameters that the ViT previously provided.
blocks.zh:
编码器-类似专用能力:专家游览. 两个系统都使用同样的稀疏的解码器,因此路由差异显示解码器如何吸收变化的视觉表现.
我们使用 MaxVio [60] 来量化专家负载不平衡,
如图10所示,两种系统在视觉符号和文本符号被聚合时,总体MaxVio同样较低,尽管无编码器值略高.
按方式划分的符号显示,视觉和文字符号的专家负载不平衡程度大大高于汇总数字。
对于文本符号,两种架构保持紧密匹配.
相比之下,在四个最大的模型尺寸中,无编码器的模型在整个培训期间显示的平均数一直较高,并显示一个更广泛的用于视觉符号的波段。
文本上的近距离匹配反对跨整个模型的路由转变,并将效果本地化为视觉处理.
这种集中与解码器一致,该解码器分配了其专家的子集,以发挥ViT先前提供的视向特定参数的作用.

blocks.en: Takeaway 4. The decoder adapts to take over visual encoding: bidirectional attention among visual tokens, shallow-layer visual processing, and concentrated expert routing (Figs. 8 – 10 ).
blocks.zh: 外卖 4. 解码器适应于接管视觉编码:视觉符号中的双向注意,浅层视觉处理,以及集中的专家路径(图8 – 10 ).

blocks.en: Figure 10: Expert load imbalance over training. MaxVio is computed jointly over visual and text tokens (left), over visual tokens only (middle), and over text tokens only (right). Higher values indicate greater imbalance.
blocks.zh: 图10:专家负载与培训不平衡。 MaxVio在视觉和文字符号(左),视觉符号(中)和文字符号(右)上共同计算。 较高的数值表明不平衡程度更大。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Encoder-Free MLLMs. Encoder-free MLLMs remove the visual encoder and pass projected image patches directly into the decoder.
Early systems such as Fuyu, EVE, and SOLO established the feasibility of this design [ 3 , 13 , 9 ] .
Moving beyond feasibility, SAIL systematically studies model and data scalability, cross-modal information flow, and visual representation learning within a single Transformer [ 30 ] .
Later work improves visual competence through alignment or distillation [ 53 , 59 , 35 , 65 ] , additional capacity dedicated to each modality [ 42 , 41 , 15 ] , native vision-language primitives [ 14 ] , and extensions to video [ 66 , 32 , 16 ] , 3D [ 52 ] , segmentation [ 68 ] , and unified understanding and generation [ 7 , 33 , 31 , 17 , 39 , 62 ] .
Recent large systems such as the Gemma 4 12B Unified model [ 22 ] and Inkling [ 54 ] also explore native multimodal input without a visual encoder.
Our work complements these efforts by comparing behavior between encoder-free and encoder-based MLLMs.
blocks.zh:
Encoder-Free MLLM. Encoder-free MLLM去除视觉编码器,并将投影图像补丁直接传入解码器.
Fuyu、EVE和SOLO等早期系统确立了这种设计的可行性[3、13、9]。
SAIL超越可行性,系统研究模型和数据可扩展性,跨模式信息流,以及单变形器内的视觉表现学习[30].
后期工作通过对齐或蒸馏[53,59,35,65],对每种模式的额外能力[42,41,15],本土视觉语言原始语[14],以及视频[66,32,16],3D[52],分化[68],以及统一理解和生成[7,33,31,17,39,62],提高了视觉能力.
最近的大型系统如Gemma 4 12B United model [22] 和 Inkling [54] 也探索没有视觉编码器的本土多式联运输入.
我们的工作通过比较无编码器和基于编码器的MLLM的行为来补充这些努力.

blocks.en:
Scaling Laws. Predicting training behavior at large scale from small runs is now standard practice, spanning loss trends, data scaling, compute-optimal allocation, and training hyperparameters [ 27 , 25 , 5 , 6 , 34 , 11 , 1 , 61 ] .
Recent work extends this methodology to native multimodal pretraining.
In particular, the compute-optimal data requirement grows faster for vision than for language in unified multimodal pretraining [ 57 ] , and native MLLMs trained under data constraints exhibit coupled scaling between the visual encoder and the language model [ 55 ] .
Others compare early and late fusion trained from scratch [ 49 ] or study how the data mixture affects the scaling of encoder-free MoE models [ 63 ] .
In contrast, we compare encoder-free models against an encoder-based baseline on a shared MoE decoder ladder, predict the compute budget at which encoder-free models catch up under both compute-optimal allocation and overtraining, and analyze how the decoder takes over visual encoding via vision-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh:
扩大法律。 从小跑中预测大规模训练行为现在是标准做法,跨越损失趋势、数据规模、计算最佳分配以及训练超参数[27、25、5、6、34、11、1、61]。
最近的工作将这种方法推广到当地多式联运预培训。
特别是,计算-最佳数据要求的视差比统一多式联运预训中的语言增长得快[57],在数据限制下培训的本地MLLMs在视觉编码器与语言模型之间进行缩放[55]。
其他人则比较从零开始训练的早期和晚聚变[49]或研究数据混合物如何影响无编码器的MOE模型的缩放[63].
对比之下,我们将无编码器模型与共享的MOE解码器阶梯上的基于编码器的基线进行比较,预测无编码器模型在计算-优化分配和过度训练下追赶的计算预算,并分析解码器如何通过视向特定适应来接管视觉编码.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Encoder-free MLLMs are less compute-efficient on the multimodal objective at the scales we evaluate. However, their compute-optimal loss decreases faster as compute increases. Our fitted scaling laws predict a crossover on the order of 10 22 10^{22} FLOPs under compute-optimal allocation and at a higher budget under 5 × 5\times overtraining. Encoder-free scaling also favors larger decoders, delays the decoder’s reliance on visual input, strengthens interactions among visual tokens, shifts visual representation transformation earlier, and concentrates expert routing. In contrast, text scaling remains largely unchanged. These findings point to future work on decoder architectures and training strategies that improve the compute efficiency of native visual input.
blocks.zh: 免编码的 MLLMs在我们评价的尺度上的多式联运目标计算效率较低。 然而,其计算-最佳损失随着计算增加而迅速减少。 我们配对的缩放定律预示着 10 22 10 Q 22 左右的交叉 在计算-最佳分配和较高预算下在5x5次过度训练下实施FLOP。 无编码器的缩放也有利于更大的解码器,延迟解码器对视觉输入的依赖,加强视觉符号之间的相互作用,更早转移视觉表现转换,并集中专家的路由. 相比之下,文本缩放基本上保持不变。 这些调查结果指出了未来在解码器架构和培训策略方面的工作,这些都提高了本土视觉输入的计算效率.

blocks.en: A.1 Visual Front End Architectures
blocks.zh: A.1 视觉前端建筑

blocks.en: Encoder-Free Front End. Both front ends produce one visual token per 32 × 32 32\times 32 pixel region. Our encoder-free front end adapts the patch projection pipeline used in the Gemma 4 12B Unified model [ 22 ] . In the original pipeline, 16 × 16 16\times 16 patches are merged in 3 × 3 3\times 3 spatial groups, yielding visual tokens that each cover a 48 × 48 48\times 48 pixel region. To ensure a controlled comparison, we instead use 2 × 2 2\times 2 merging, matching the encoder-based front end in both visual-token granularity and token count. Each merged patch of raw pixels passes through a LayerNorm, a linear layer, and a second LayerNorm. Learned factorized 2D position embeddings, obtained by summing separate embeddings for the two spatial axes, are then added, followed by a third LayerNorm, an RMSNorm, and a linear projection to the decoder width.
blocks.zh: 编码器 - 自由前端 两端前端每32×32 32\time32像素区域产生1个视觉符号. 我国无编码器前端改造Gemma 4 12B统一型号使用的补丁投影管[22]. 在原管线中,16×16 16\时的16个补丁被合并为3×3 3\时的3个空间组,产生视觉符号,每个区覆盖48×4848\时的48像素区域. 为了保证有控制的比较,我们而是使用2×2 2\times 2 合并,在可视的托盘颗粒度和符号计数中匹配基于编码器的前端. 每个合并的原始像素补丁都经过一个图层Norm,一个线性图层,和一个第二个图层Norm. 被分解的2D位置嵌入法,通过为两个空间轴进行交错的分离嵌入法获得,然后添加第三层Norm,RMSNorm,以及解码器宽度的线性投影法.

blocks.en: Encoder-Based Front End. The encoder-based front end uses a pretrained SigLIP 2 ViT [ 58 ] with 27 layers, width 1152, patch size 16, and AnyRes processing. A 2 × 2 2\times 2 ConvPool adapter and a projector match the encoder-free visual-token granularity. We choose this roughly 400M encoder scale as a representative practical setting used by recent advanced MLLMs [ 23 , 2 , 29 ] . The ViT is trained jointly with the decoder in every run, while its architecture and parameter count remain fixed across decoder scales.
blocks.zh: 基于编码器的前端. 基于编码器的前端使用预先训练的SigLIP 2 VIT [58],有27层,宽度1152,补丁尺寸16,以及AnyRes处理. 一个2×2 2\times 2 ConvPool适配器和一个投影仪匹配无编码的可视-托肯颗粒性. 我们选择这个大约400M编码器比例尺作为最近高级的MLLM[23, 2, 29]使用的有代表性的实用设置. 在每次运行中,ViT与解码器共同训练,而其架构和参数计数则在解码器尺度上保持固定.

blocks.en: Matched Comparison Protocol. Both front ends use the same preprocessing pipeline, consume the same pixels, and pass the same number of visual tokens to the decoder. The main comparison therefore holds visual content and token count fixed while varying the representation attached to each token and the attention pattern over visual tokens described in § 3.3 . Fixing the ViT across the ladder isolates decoder scaling and avoids introducing joint scaling of the encoder and decoder as an additional variable. Consequently, the ViT accounts for a smaller fraction of total model capacity as the decoder grows, and the reported scaling trends are conditional on this regime with a fixed encoder size. Jointly scaling the visual encoder would define a different allocation problem, requiring a separate sweep that balances potential representation gains against additional compute in the front end.
blocks.zh: 匹配的比较协议 。 两个前端都使用相同的预处理管道,消耗相同的像素,并将同样数量的视觉符号传递给解码器. 因此,主要比较是固定视觉内容和信物计数,同时改变每个信物的表示方式和注意模式,而不是第3.3节所述信物。 修整跨梯子的VIT会隔离解码器缩放,避免引入联合缩放编码器和解码器作为附加变量. 因此,随着解码器的增大,ViT占模型总容量的一小部分,报告的缩放趋势取决于这种固定编码器大小的制度。 联合缩放视觉编码器将界定一个不同的分配问题,要求进行单独的扫描,以平衡潜在表示收益与前端的额外计算。

blocks.en: A.2 Decoder Architecture and Model Ladder
blocks.zh: A.2 解码器建筑和模型梯

blocks.en:
The two systems share a complete ladder of 11 rungs. Model depth and width vary across rungs, while the MoE topology remains fixed. Every rung uses 256 256 routed experts, activates the top 8 8 experts for each token, and includes one shared expert [ 12 ] . The activation ratio of routed experts is therefore fixed at 8 / 256 = 1 / 32 8/256=1/32 across model scales, keeping all rungs within a consistent architectural family. The first layer is dense, followed by MoE layers.
All models use RMSNorm [ 67 ] and RoPE [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh:
两个系统共用一个完整的11径梯. 模型深度和宽度因跑道而异,而教育部的地形则保持不变。 每条路由使用256,256位路由专家,激活每条路由前8位专家,并包括一名共享专家[12]. 因此,路由专家的激活率被固定在8/256=1/32 8/256=1/32的模型尺度上,将所有径流都保留在一个一致的建筑家庭中。 第一层密布,其次是MOE层.
所有型号都使用RMSNorm [67]和ROPE [51].

blocks.en: A.3 Training Setup
blocks.zh: A.3 培训设置

blocks.en: Optimization and Hyperparameters. All runs use a sequence length of 4,096 4{,}096 , the Muon optimizer [ 26 ] , and 2,000 2{,}000 warmup steps. Training hyperparameters are selected as a function of model scale using an internal scaling law. In particular, the batch size and learning rate vary across the model ladder. At each rung, identical hyperparameters are used for the encoder-based and encoder-free MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 优化和超参数。 所有运行都使用4,096 4{,}096的序列长度,穆恩优化器[26],以及2000 2{,}000的热身步骤. 使用内部缩放定律选择培训超参数作为模型尺度的一种功能。 具体来说,批量大小和学习率在模型阶梯上各不相同. 在每个运行时,均使用相同的超参数来进行基于编码器和无编码器的MLLMs.

blocks.en: Overtraining Runs and Multiplier Fitting. For both model families, we train compute-optimal model sizes at k ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } k\in\{2,3,4,5\} . To allow for deviations from the idealized separable loss model underlying Eq. 7 , we keep E E , K s K_{s} , and γ s \gamma_{s} fixed to their compute-optimal estimates and fit an empirical multiplier g s emp ​ ( k ) g_{s}^{\mathrm{emp}}(k) using the available overtraining runs. At k = 5 k=5 , the fitted multipliers are 0.645 0.645 for encoder-free and 0.692 0.692 for encoder-based models. These empirical estimates are used for the overtraining analysis in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: 过度训练 跑步和乘数 对两个模范家庭来说,我们训练计算-最佳模范大小为k {{2,3,4,5}k\in2,3,4,5}。 为了允许偏离Eq 7下的理想化分离损失模型,我们利用现有的过度训练运行,将E、Ks K_{s}和 γ s\gamma_{s}固定在计算-最佳估计值上,并安装经验乘数g s emp (k) g_{s}^{\mathrm{emp}}(k) 。 在k=5k=5时,安装的乘数为无编码器0.645 0.645,无编码器型号0.692 0.692. 这些经验估计用于图5中的过度培训分析。

blocks.en: A.4 Training and Validation Data
blocks.zh: A.4 培训和验证数据

blocks.en: Training Mixture. The corpus is a 1 : 1 1{:}1 mixture of text and multimodal data. Since we focus on architectural scaling rather than effects of the data mixture, we keep this ratio fixed rather than treating it as a study variable. The balanced mixture provides sufficient multimodal training tokens for robust estimation of multimodal scaling. Multimodal sources cover tasks such as captioning, charts, grounding, GUI, OCR, STEM, and knowledge. Text sources cover domains such as STEM, code, books, and wikis.
blocks.zh: 训练混合. 主体为1:1{{}1文本和多式联运数据的混合体。 由于我们注重的是建筑缩放而不是数据混合物的效果,所以我们保持这个比例固定下来,而不是把它当作一个研究变量处理. 平衡的混合物提供了充分的多式联运培训标志,可用于对多式联运规模的有力估计。 多式联运源包括标题、图表、地面、图形用户界面、OCR、STEM和知识等任务。 文本来源覆盖了STEM,代码,书籍和维基等域.

blocks.en: Validation Losses. Validation data are disjoint from training and identical across systems. We separately track losses on pure text and on multimodal topics: text losses are computed on sequences containing no visual tokens, whereas multimodal losses are computed over text prediction tokens in sequences conditioned on images, with visual tokens masked out from the loss, and are grouped by topic. These masked visual positions remain included in D mm D_{\mathrm{mm}} and in decoder FLOP accounting. The primary validation view weights major topics uniformly while preserving the training mixture weights of sources within each topic.
blocks.zh: 鉴定损失。 验证数据与培训脱节,各系统相同。 我们分别追踪纯文本和多式联运专题的损失:文本损失按没有视觉符号的序列计算,而多式联运损失则按图像为条件的序列在文本预测符号上计算,视觉符号从损失中掩盖出来,按专题分类。 这些遮盖的视觉位置仍然包含在Dmm D_{\ mathrm{mm}}]和解码器FLOP核算中. 主要验证观点对主要专题进行统一加权,同时保留每个专题内各种来源的培训混合加权。

blocks.en: A.5 Scaling Law Fitting Setup
blocks.zh: A.5 扩大定律设置

blocks.en:
Following prior scaling law work [ 27 , 25 ] , we use held-out validation loss as the primary metric and fit separate laws for the text and multimodal objectives, ℒ text \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}} and ℒ mm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{mm}} .

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Validation Curve Envelope. We adapt the envelope approach of Chinchilla [ 25 ] , which uses training loss curves, to validation loss trajectories: the held-out validation loss of each run, measured at its intermediate checkpoints. At each of 200 logarithmically spaced compute budgets, we linearly interpolate each trajectory in log compute and fit a local quadratic in log ⁡ M \log M to the five model scales around the lowest observed loss on the ladder. The quadratic vertex gives a continuous estimate of the optimum derived from the trajectories. Because adjacent budgets are highly correlated, we aggregate these estimates by their median within 24 equal bins in log compute before fitting the allocation and loss laws. We use Huber regression in log space for the allocation laws to limit the influence of isolated errors from local interpolation. Unlike the six IsoFLOP profiles, this estimator constructs a dense frontier from points along the validation trajectories.

blocks.en: B.3 Sensitivity to the Irreducible Loss
blocks.zh: B.3 对无法减少的损失的敏感性

blocks.en: This subsection specifies the fit with a common E E used for the loss–compute laws, then tests how the estimates move when E E is perturbed (Fig. 14 and Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 本小节具体说明了损失所用的通用E E 的配体——计算定律,然后测试估计值在E E 被扰动时如何移动(图14和图3)。

blocks.en: Common Irreducible Loss. Following prior scaling law work [ 24 , 25 ] , we interpret the irreducible term E E as the conditional entropy floor induced by the data distribution and prediction objective. Because the encoder-free and encoder-based systems are trained and evaluated on the same examples with the same next-token objective, their Bayes-optimal loss floor is shared. We therefore impose one E o E_{o} per objective across architectures, while allowing the finite compute terms K s K_{s} and γ s \gamma_{s} to differ.
blocks.zh: 常见的不可减少的损失。 继先前的缩放定律工作[24,25]之后,我们把不可减少的术语E E 解释为数据分布和预测目标引发的有条件的py底. 由于无编码器和基于编码器的系统都是在同样的例子上以相同的下接目标进行训练和评价的,因此他们的贝叶-最佳损失底片被共享. 因此,我们把每个目标加到一个Eo E_{o} 跨结构,同时允许有限的计算术语 K s K_{s} 和 γ s\gamma_{s} 不同。

blocks.en: This constraint of a common E E is a structural assumption, not a claim that our observations at finite scale identify the asymptote. Its interpretation further assumes that both model families can eliminate approximation error that depends on architecture as scale grows. In our setting, with six multimodal frontier points per system over approximately one decade of compute, E E trades off strongly with the fitted slope. Separate floors for each architecture can therefore absorb differences within the finite range without reliably identifying distinct entropy limits. More broadly, asymptotic parameters of scaling laws are known to be sensitive to the fitting sample and specification [ 4 , 10 , 46 ] . We consequently treat the constraint as theoretically motivated and test below which conclusions depend on it.
blocks.zh: 共同的EE的这种限制是一种结构假设,而不是声称我们有限规模的观测能辨别出不对称. 其解释还进一步假设,两个模型家族都可以消除随着规模扩大而取决于建筑的近似误差. 在我们的环境下,在计算大约十年的时间里,每个系统有6个多式联运前沿点,E E与适合的坡度大打折扣。 因此,每个架构的单独楼层可以吸收有限范围内的差异,而不能可靠地确定不同的py限. 更广泛地说,关于缩放定律的不对称参数已知对适当的样本和规格[4、10、46]敏感。 因此,我们把这种限制视为理论上的动机和检验,在这种检验之下,结论取决于它。

blocks.en: B.4 Conditional Bootstrap Uncertainty
blocks.zh: B.4 有条件的靴子陷阱

blocks.en: In this section, we use a conditional residual bootstrap with paired resampling across architectures to characterize fitting uncertainty in the multimodal loss–compute and allocation exponents, their differences between architectures, and the extrapolated crossover budgets under compute-optimal allocation and 5 × 5\times overtraining.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们使用附带条件的剩余靴子,并配对跨结构的复刻图,以描述多式联运损失的适配不确定性 — — 计算和分配指数、它们之间的结构差异,以及计算-优化分配和5×5乘过度训练下推断的交叉预算。

blocks.en:
Bootstrap Protocol. For each architecture, we compute the residuals between the six estimated optimal losses from the IsoFLOP profiles and the corresponding values of the fitted compute law, then center them by subtracting the mean for each architecture.
At each bootstrap replicate, we sample six matched residual pairs with replacement and add them to the fitted losses at the six fixed compute budgets.
We then jointly refit the two loss–compute scaling laws by least squares on the untransformed loss scale, estimating a common E mm E_{\mathrm{mm}} anew in each replicate.
This paired resampling preserves the association at each budget between the encoder-free and encoder-based residuals.
blocks.zh:

在每套靴子复制一次时,我们抽取了6对配对的剩余配对和替换,并将其加到6个固定计算预算的配对损失中。
然后,我们共同重制两个损失 — — 在未转换的损失尺度上用最小的方块计算定律, 估计每个复制中都有一个通用的 Emm E_{\mathrm{mm}}} 。
这种配对的复刻保留了每个预算在无编码器和基于编码器的残基之间的关联.

blocks.en: C.3 Summary

blocks.en: Neither conclusion of the main text depends on the accounting convention. For allocation, encoder-free training favors larger models than encoder-based training under both conventions, and encoder-free models retain the larger loss–compute exponent. For the crossover, charging the fixed ∼ 400 {\sim}400 M ViT only adds cost to encoder-based runs and leaves the encoder-free frontier unchanged, so it shifts every comparison at equal loss toward encoder-free models. At the crossover under decoder accounting in § 3.2 , encoder-free models therefore already require less total compute, and the crossover under full accounting occurs no later than 6.1 × 10 21 6.1\times 10^{21} FLOPs. We do not refit a numerical crossover under this convention.

blocks.en: Appendix G Downstream Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录G 下游 评价

blocks.en: Our scaling analyses are based on validation loss. To check whether the same trends hold on downstream tasks, we evaluate the pretrained checkpoints on a set of multimodal benchmarks, without any further training.
blocks.zh: 我们的缩放分析是基于验证损失。 为了检查下游任务是否保持同样的趋势,我们在没有任何进一步培训的情况下,根据一套多式联运基准评估预先训练过的检查站。

blocks.en: G.1 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: G.1 基准

blocks.en: CV-Bench [ 56 ] probes basic visual abilities, covering two-dimensional spatial relationships and counting as well as three-dimensional depth and distance. POPE [ 36 ] measures object hallucination by asking whether a queried object appears in the image, and we pool its random, popular, and adversarial subsets. MME [ 20 ] poses concise yes/no questions spanning perception and cognition. We report accuracy on all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: CV-Bench [56]探测基本视觉能力,涵盖二维空间关系和计数以及三维深度和距离. POPE[36]通过询问被询问的物体在图像中是否出现来度量幻觉,我们汇集其随机的,流行的,对抗性的子集. MME [20] 提出了涵盖感知和认知的简明的“是”/“否”问题。 我们报告这三项基准的准确性。

blocks.en: ChartQA [ 43 ] requires extracting values from charts and reasoning over them visually or logically. We report relaxed accuracy, which applies the standard relative tolerance to numerical answers. DocVQA [ 44 ] evaluates question answering over document images, where both textual content and layout matter. We report average normalized Levenshtein similarity, which gives partial credit to near-miss answers. AI2D [ 28 ] tests reasoning about the components and relationships in scientific diagrams, and we report multiple-choice accuracy. TextVQA [ 50 ] requires reading text in natural images and relating it to the surrounding scene, and we report the VQA consensus score against human answers.
blocks.zh: ChartQA [43] 需要从图表中提取数值,并对其进行视觉或逻辑上的推理. 我们报告放松的精确度,它把标准相对容忍度应用于数字答案。 DocVQA [44] 评价对文档图像的回答问题,其中文字内容和布局都很重要. 我们报告说,平均来说,莱文施泰因的相似性已经正常化,这在一定程度上归功于近乎失误的答复。 AI2D[28]测试科学图中组件和关系的推理,我们报告多选精度. TextVQA [50] 需要用自然图像读取文本并将其与周围的场景联系起来,我们报告VQA共识分数与人类答案相对.

blocks.en: RealWorldQA [ 64 ] tests understanding of real-world scenes, including images captured from vehicles. MMStar [ 8 ] consists of questions curated so that answering them requires visual evidence, spanning a range of perception and reasoning abilities. MMBench [ 38 ] offers broad coverage of multimodal capabilities, and we use its English development set. ScienceQA-IMG [ 40 ] is the subset of ScienceQA whose school-level science questions come with images. We evaluate answer selection on it without providing the reference explanations. We report accuracy on all four benchmarks.
blocks.zh: RealWorldQA [64]测试对现实世界场景的理解,包括从车辆中捕获的图像. MMStar [8] 由解答的问题组成,这样回答这些问题需要视觉证据,跨越一系列认知和推理能力. MMBench [38]提供了广泛的多式联运能力,我们使用其英文开发集。 ScienceQA-IMG [40] 是ScienceQA的子集,其学校一级的科学问题伴随着图像. 我们评价其中的答案选择,但没有提供参考解释。 我们报告所有四项基准的准确性。

blocks.en: G.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: G.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate every pretrained checkpoint in the same 3-shot setting: each query is preceded by three solved examples, and all models share the same examples, prompt, and image preprocessing. The examples are drawn from the training split when one exists. Otherwise, we draw them from three images in the evaluation set and exclude all questions about those images from scoring. Images are resized with their aspect ratio preserved, to at most 192 visual tokens per example and 768 for the query, and the full prompt is kept within 4,096 4{,}096 tokens. We use no external OCR, reference explanations, or test-time fine-tuning. For multiple-choice and yes/no questions, the model selects the candidate answer to which it assigns the highest likelihood. For open-ended questions, it decodes greedily for up to 32 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一3发的设定中评价每个预先训练过的检查点:每个查询前都有三个解开的例子,所有模型都共享相同的例子,即时,图像预处理. 实例来自培训存在时的分裂。 否则,我们从评价中的三个图像中抽取这些图像,并将有关这些图像的所有问题排除在评分之外。 图像的尺寸被调整,其外观比被保留,最多每例有192个视觉信使,查询时有768个,完整的提示被保存在4,096 4{,}096个信使之内. 我们没有使用外部的OCR,参考解释, 或测试时间微调。 对于多选题和是/否题,模型会选择其指定最高概率的候选人答案. 对于开放式的问题,它贪婪地解码了多达32个令牌.

blocks.en: G.3 Results
blocks.zh: G.3 结果

blocks.en: Encoder-free models still score below encoder-based models at the scales we evaluate, but the gap narrows as training compute increases (Fig. 20 ). At the largest token budget, the gap also tends to narrow as the model grows (Tab. 6 ). Both trends are consistent with the loss-based findings.
blocks.zh: 无编码器模型在我们评价的尺度上仍然得分低于基于编码器的模型,但随着训练计算增加(图20),缺口缩小. 在最大的象征性预算中,随着模型的增长,差距也趋于缩小(第6段)。

blocks.en: Figure 20: Downstream benchmark performance against multimodal training compute. The y-axis is the unweighted average 3-shot score over the 11 benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图20:下游基准业绩对照多式联运培训计算。 Y轴是11个基准的未加权平均3发分.

blocks.en: Table 6: 3-shot benchmark scores at about 100B training tokens. “Based” and “Free” denote encoder-based and encoder-free models, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表6:约100B级训练标志的3发基准分数. “基于”和“自由”分别表示基于编码器的模型和无编码器的模型。
